interpretation: V2.8.6 state-invariant dual compression remains independently replicated; V2.8.7 rejects only the frozen Q5 (>80%) versus Q1 (<=20%) Setup-shape promotion.
The all-market and STRESSED D+10 spreads are positive with confidence intervals above zero, but the frozen contract required the CALM D+10 confidence interval to be entirely above zero as well.
Because the CALM lower confidence bound is below zero, the all-gates-must-pass contract requires rejection even though the miss is numerically small.
This rejection must not be rescued by alternative percentile thresholds, optional stopping, coefficient refit to the observed fold2 outcome, sample replacement, or post-result gate changes.

problem_elimination_pass.final_user_goal: Obtain a robust prospective Setup candidate that survives independent validation, not make the V2.8.7 Q5 candidate pass.
hard_constraints: Keep the frozen V2.8.7 Q5/Q1 definitions, bootstrap, sample and PASS conditions unchanged.
Honor the terminal rejection with no reevaluation.
Keep fold3 and fold4 untouched until a new candidate and its gates are frozen.
Do not authorize Setup, First60, Episode or live emission from V2.8.7.
problem_elimination_pass.soft_constraint_removed: A prospective Setup does not have to be the top quintile of the V2.8.6 dual-compression score.

priority_actions.Delete: Delete Q5 as a promotion candidate; do not spend more research budget trying to rescue it.
priority_actions.Avoid: Do not use fold3 as a diagnostic set for the failed Q5 definition.
priority_actions.Absorb: Reuse already-consumed folds 0-2, the frozen feature engine, source snapshots and existing metrics for future hypothesis generation where applicable.
priority_actions.Substitute: If research continues, formulate a materially new Setup-shape hypothesis rather than another percentile cut of the same observed fold2 result.
priority_actions.Precompute_Reuse: Do not re-fetch or re-run already frozen V2.8.6/V2.8.7 evidence unless a new hypothesis strictly requires a new derived field.
priority_actions.Optimize: Not applicable at this stage; no local tuning of the rejected Q5 candidate is permitted.

fold_disposition.fold3: reserved untouched validation for one future pre-frozen Setup candidate
fold_disposition.fold4: reserved untouched final cross-sectional holdout after fold3 success

next_stage_constraints: Use only already-consumed folds 0-2 for hypothesis generation and development diagnostics.
A new candidate must be materially distinct from post-hoc Q5 percentile rescue.
Freeze exactly one candidate definition, implementation binding and evaluation gate before any fold3 price/outcome access.
Fold3 is validation, not tuning; a fold3 failure cannot be tuned on fold3.
Fold4 remains sealed unless the pre-frozen fold3 gate passes.
No Setup, First60, Episode or live authorization is created by entering V2.8.8.
